name: GitHub
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: Markdown the way GitHub shows a README: a system sans on white or GitHub's dark page, ruled level-1 and level-2 headings, grey quotes, striped tables and GitHub's own code colours. Written by us after github-markdown-css; not affiliated with GitHub.

zh.description: 像 GitHub 显示 README 那样排版：系统无衬线字体，白底或 GitHub 的深色页面，一、二级标题带分隔线，灰色引用，隔行底色的表格，代码用 GitHub 自己的配色。参照 github-markdown-css 编写，与 GitHub 官方无关。
